concept: Tabs are the section names printed along the case of an appliance, like the scale under a selector. The chosen room's name is set in medium weight with one ink index mark under it, and the screen below shows that room.

default_to_avoid.pattern: Material tabs with a coloured sliding underline indicator
default_to_avoid.why_not: A coloured bar spends a hue on a selection, which P1 forbids, and the bar gliding across the row is a movement that no state of the device asked for, against P6.

default_to_avoid.pattern: browser folder tabs: raised boxes joined to a bordered panel
default_to_avoid.why_not: A raised tab gives navigation the height of a key, so it reads as a part that does something to the device instead of printing that names a section (P5).

references.source: Braun T 1000 and SK 55 cases (Dieter Rams): function names printed in one row on the case, the chosen one shown by a mark beside it
Braun regie receiver tuning scale: printed names with one index mark at the chosen station
WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices, Tabs pattern: tablist, tab, tabpanel, roving tabindex, automatic activation
apps/lab/tabs/index.html: printed names with an index mark, latching key bank, tuning scale with a needle

derivation.consequence: printing is flat on the material, with no shadow and no emboss
derivation.form: A tab has no height, no shadow and no travel: it is printing on the case, so it never reads as a key that changes the device.

derivation.consequence: rotaries are circles with one index mark
derivation.form: The chosen name gets one short ink index mark under it, the same single mark a rotary uses, instead of a bar the width of the word.

derivation.consequence: links, borders, icons, selections and charts never use it
derivation.form: Names and the index mark are ink on plastic; the chosen tab is never orange and carries no fill.

derivation.consequence: one grotesk, regular and medium only; hierarchy by size and position
derivation.form: Released names are regular weight in secondary ink; the chosen name turns medium weight in primary ink, with the mark under it.

derivation.consequence: no entry choreography, no idle animation; transitions only on state
derivation.form: The index mark appears at once under the new name and the panel swaps without a slide or fade between sections.

derivation.consequence: fixed positions, so a unit's layout does not reflow between states
derivation.form: Each name reserves the width of its medium weight, so choosing a tab never shifts its neighbours along the row.

options.name: printed names on the case with one ink index mark under the chosen name
latching key bank, the SegmentedControl silhouette
tuning scale with a needle that slides to the chosen name

variants.reason: A keeps navigation as flat printing (P5) so it cannot be mistaken for a setting; B looks exactly like SegmentedControl and reads as a mode key on the device, and C's sliding needle is the moving indicator P6 forbids for anything that is not a change of state.

root.why: The root holds the printed row above the panels, so the row stays in one fixed position for every section.

list.why: The names sit in one row on the body's inset line, a small gap apart, with no rule drawn across the row.

tab.why: Each printed name is a target at least 44px tall and wide, even though it draws no key around itself.

word.why: The word stacks the visible name over a hidden medium copy, so its width holds when the weight changes.

text.why: The visible name is printed in the label size, regular in secondary ink until its section is chosen.

ghost.why: A hidden copy set in medium weight reserves the chosen width, so the names never shift between states.

mark.why: One short ink index mark with round ends sits under the chosen name, like the single mark on a rotary.

panel.why: The panel shows the chosen section only and is focusable, so a screen reader moves from the name into its content.

hover.why: Hover darkens a released name one ink step and nothing rises, because printing on a case does not move.

focus-visible.why: Keyboard focus draws the same dark ring around the name or the panel as on every part of the system.

aria-selected=true.why: The chosen name turns medium weight in primary ink and shows its index mark, a change of weight and shape, not hue.

@media prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.why: Under reduce motion nothing on the row moves, and the hover ink step keeps its short fade because a fade of colour moves nothing.

@media forced-colors: active.why: In forced colours the index mark is drawn in the system text colour, so the chosen name keeps its mark.

color.why: The ink step on hover comes in over 120ms and goes back over 240ms on the decelerating curve (motion.hover with kiln.state), fast in and slow out, while the mark itself never moves.
